title: Mexican art historians weigh in on upcoming Kahlo’s auction that could fetch up to $60 million
summary: MEXICO CITY (AP) — Frida Kahlo’s “El sueno (La cama)” — in English, “The Dream (The Bed)” — is causing a stir among art historians as its estimated $40 million to $60 million price tag would make it the most expensive work by any female or Latin American artist when it goes to auction later […]
